Redesigning Inkompass – Cultivating Global Talent for a Smoke-Free Future

ClientPhilip Morris International
DisciplinesUX Design
IndustryEnterprise
Timeline2022

About

Philip Morris International partnered with Wugweb to redesign Inkompass, their global talent management platform, creating an intuitive experience that supports their vision of a smoke-free future through empowered employees.

Challenges

Global Scale

The platform needed to serve thousands of employees across multiple countries with diverse cultural contexts and languages.

Complex Talent Workflows

Managing performance reviews, career development, and succession planning required a sophisticated yet intuitive interface.

Change Management

Transitioning from legacy systems to a modern platform required careful UX to ensure user adoption across all levels.

Solutions

Unified Dashboard Experience

A personalized dashboard gave employees and managers at-a-glance access to their most important tasks and metrics.

Simplified Performance Reviews

We redesigned the review process with guided steps, smart templates, and real-time feedback to reduce administrative burden.

Career Development Pathways

Visual career mapping tools helped employees understand growth opportunities and the skills needed to advance.

Impact

Higher Engagement

User adoption rates increased significantly post-launch, with employees spending more time on development activities.

Reduced Admin Time

Managers reported spending less time on administrative tasks and more on meaningful development conversations.

Global Standardization

The unified platform ensured consistent talent processes across all regions while allowing for local flexibility.
